review.notes: Conflict preserved, not resolved: the baseline's cdb text is v1 (CP01-EN015, 2006-11-11) 'when your opponent activates a CARD that has an effect which destroys...', and v2 (TU02-EN007, 2010-01-09) - the printing actually in circulation at the 2010-04-24 Edison snapshot - is equally card-scoped, while v3 (GLD3-EN041, 2010-06-18) broadened the trigger to 'a card OR effect'. Upstream's GOAT script does not reproduce the narrow card-only scope: its single-line diff leaves the modern trigger scope intact, so as shipped it behaves like the v5/v6 version minus the Damage Step allowance. Two independent parties treat the GLD3 wording as clarification rather than change - Project Ignis by not narrowing the script, and EdisonFormat.com, which states the era card can be chained to a card or an effect while openly conceding that SJC Edison was played with the TU2 printing and that adopting GLD3 is a community-convention choice. I therefore record only the Damage Step transition as implementation-relevant and flag the scope tension rather than inventing a second change the script cannot support. Intermediate rewordings v1 -> v5 (TU02 'Activate only by paying', DT05-EN041 'Spell/Trap Card or Effect Monster's effect', LCYW PSCT) are collapsed into this note.

effective.basis: TCG release of OP10-EN021 (OTS Tournament Pack 10), the first printing whose text drops '(except during the Damage Step)'

event.historical_text: When your opponent activates a card that has an effect which destroys 1 or more monster(s) on the field, pay 1500 Life Points to negate the activation of that card and destroy it.
event.modern_text: When your opponent activates a Spell/Trap Card or monster effect that would destroy a monster(s) on the field: Pay 1500 LP; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.
event.summary: Functional erratum: the Damage Step restriction was removed. The GOAT script's only difference from the modern one is that it does not set EFFECT_FLAG_DAMAGE_STEP+EFFECT_FLAG_DAMAGE_CAL on the activation, so the era card cannot be activated during the Damage Step at all - upstream annotates it 'Cannot be used during the damage step'. The printed text stated that restriction outright from LCYW-EN135 (v5, 2012) through PGL2-EN074 (v6, 2015) and lost it at OP10-EN021 (v7), after which the modern implementation is correct.
